# Role

This skill responds to hello requests and returns a greeting with the current timestamp.

## Workflow

1. When invoked, respond with "Hello!" followed by the current date and time
2. Format the response as: "Hello! Current time: [timestamp]"

## Example Response

```
Hello! Current time: 2026-02-04T10:30:00Z
```
